final: WITH source_averages AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM source_averages) SELECT a.fundflux, a.avg_y_vs_x_difference, a.area_to_volume, a.area_to_volume - c.avg_area_to_volume AS above_average FROM source_averages AS a CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE a.area_to_volume > c.avg_area_to_volume
